content: {"rules": ["Model forecasts consistently overshoot true outcomes by 2-4% due to a systematic upward bias in the 30-day horizon.", "Apply a mean-reversion correction factor of -15% to model predictions when historical volatility exceeds 8%.", "Reduce forecast confidence significantly if sentiment history shows conflicting signals between recent bullish spikes and declining price trends.", "Adjust downward by 10-12% when the last three days of sentiment are uniformly high (1.00) but prices remain flat or slightly decreasing.", "Account for a 5-day lag in market reaction to major sentiment shifts by shifting forecasted turning points earlier.", "Invert the correction logic if the model predicts a drop while sentiment history indicates strong bullish momentum.", "Reduce forecast values by 8% when the last 10 days of price data show a clear downtrend despite positive sentiment readings."] }
